name: APEX public development tasks
access_note: Public, ungated. Needs three linux/amd64 images (about 5 GB) and LLM grader credentials before it can run here.
native_metric_note: Leaderboard metric is Mean Criteria@3 with a different judge and an unreleased grading template, so a local score is not comparable to it. harbor==0.20.0 is enforced by run_task.sh. Harbor repo created 2026-09-14, pin the sha. The two repos disagree on 3 rubric criteria (tasks 4, 5, 7).
restrictions: results must be labeled "APEX public development tasks / Harbor / local evaluation"
never present as a private leaderboard score
keep data/dev.jsonl, tasks/*.json, tasks/*/solution, tasks/*/tests, mercor.json, agent.json and the verifier image away from the agent

name: DABstep
access_note: Public, ungated. Official scoring only through the leaderboard Space, which needs HF login and permanently publishes answers, org name and username. Validated leaderboard closed 2026-07-22; unvalidated still open.
split: tasks/default (answers hidden); tasks/dev has 10 with answers
native_metric_note: Dataset HEAD moves on every leaderboard submission, always load with revision=. Local scoring is only possible on the 10 dev tasks.
restrictions: receiving a score from the publisher is not independent validation
no submission without explicit human approval
scores from mirror_eval.external.dabstep.score_answer are a LOCAL APPROXIMATION, not the official scorer
never mount the task_scores or submissions configs: rows with score=True are effectively gold answers for hidden tasks

name: Finance Agent (original)
access_note: Public 50-row sample of a 537-question set. The rest is not public.
native_metric_note: Exact metric formula and scorer are not public. Answer and Rubric columns are answer-bearing.
restrictions: never mix original Finance Agent results with v2 results
name the exact version next to every number

name: Finance Agent v2 (public portion)
access_note: 27 public samples run locally. Validation set (450) is licensed on request, test set (450) is private, and the official jury scorer is on the gated Vals platform.
native_metric_note: All-pass is the secondary metric. No scorer code in the repo, so a local number is our own judge on their rubric, not a Vals score. Rubric column is answer-bearing.
restrictions: never mix v2 results with original Finance Agent results
public portion only, say so next to every number

name: BenchRec
access_note: Public on Kaggle, version 3 (2026-02-22). The gold solution CSV and a sample submission are public files, keep both evaluator-side.
native_metric_note: No official scorer ships with the dataset and row counts are not exposed by the API. Anything we compute is a custom metric on BenchRec data.
restrictions: custom metrics must be labeled custom unless the native scorer is used
BenchRec_cash_v1.0_solution.csv and MatcherByChatGPT_submission.csv stay evaluator-side

name: Invoice Sandbox

native_metric_note: One task scored over 18 customers. README says 110 PDFs, manifest and tree say 112. gold_master/ is the agent-visible fixture; answer_key/ and scripts/ are private.
restrictions: ingestion diagnostic only
